title: 2027 Kia K4 Hatchback Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 Kia K4 Hatchback features updated interior and exterior color options, but is otherwise unchanged from the 2026 model.
body_markdown:
The Kia K4 Hatchback is part of the brand’s value-oriented compact car lineup, alongside the K4 sedan. Competitors include the Honda Civic, the Toyota Corolla, the Mazda3, and the Volkswagen Jetta.

## What’s New for the 2027 Kia K4 Hatchback


The Kia K4 Hatchback carries over mostly unchanged for 2027, having arrived as an all-new addition to the K4 lineup for the 2026 model year. The hatchback was introduced slightly later than the K4 sedan, which debuted for 2025. The changes for the 2027 K4 Hatchback mirror those applied to the 2027 K4 sedan, **[which we cover separately](https://www.cargurus.com/research/articles/2027-kia-k4-pricing-specs-release-date)** . That means a GT-Line Premium Package configuration that now features 18-inch black-finished alloy wheels, along with an available red interior color scheme when Steel Gray paintwork is specified.


## Design


From the front, the Kia K4 Hatchback resembles its sedan sibling, with its sleek nose, crisp lighting, and bold wheel designs. Past the rear doors, the body is completely different, and it's about a foot shorter than the sedan. It’s a sharp, smart look that’s more modern than most small hatchbacks, and suits the K4 well.


## Powertrain


The K4 Hatchback is available with two powertrains. The base 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine, which powers all but the top GT-Line Turbo model, pairs with a continuously variable transmission (CVT) and is rated for a meek 147 horsepower and 132 pound-feet of torque. The GT-Line Turbo features a turbocharged 1.6-liter four-cylinder engine with 190 hp and 195 lb-ft of torque, and an eight-speed automatic transmission. Both engines come exclusively with front-wheel drive (FWD). The base engine earns an EPA rating of 30 mpg combined; for the turbo model it drops to 28 mpg.


## Interior


The K4 Hatchback offers impressive interior space and an attractive design, even if some cheaper materials remind occupants of its budget price point. It comes standard with cloth upholstery, manually adjustable front seats, keyless entry, and remote start. Available upgrades include split-folding rear seats, cloth upholstery with synthetic leather trim, synthetic leather upholstery in different color combinations, power-adjustable front seats, heated front seats, ventilated front seats, and ambient lighting. The K4 Hatchback has 22.2 cubic feet of cargo space, which opens up to a maximum of 59.3 cubic feet with the rear seats folded.


## Technology


In base EX trim, the Kia K4 Hatchback comes standard with a 4-inch digital information display and a 12.3-inch touchscreen infotainment display. The infotainment system includes wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity and a six-speaker stereo. Available features include a 12.3-inch digital display housed with the touchscreen under a panoramic glass panel, wireless charging, navigation, and an eight-speaker Harman Kardon premium audio system.

## Safety


The K4 Hatchback features a comprehensive list of advanced safety and driver-assistance features, packaged under Kia’s Drive Wise name. Standard tech includes forward-collision warning, automatic emergency braking, adaptive cruise control, intersection turn assist, blind-spot monitors, lane-departure warning, lane-keep assist, lane-centering assist, rear cross-traffic alert, safe-exit assist, and high-beam assist. Options include a surround-view camera system, a blind-spot camera system, front cross-traffic alert, reverse automatic braking, evasive steering assist, and parking sensors. Kia also offers a navigation-based speed reduction feature for the adaptive cruise control system. The optional Highway Driving Assist system offers semi-autonomous driving support and, for GT-Line Turbo models, adds a lane-change assist function. The Kia K4 Hatchback earned a five-star overall safety rating from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, though it received mixed safety ratings in 2026 Insurance Institute for Highway Safety testing.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2027 Kia K4 Hatchback is available now and the base K4 Hatchback EX started at $25,090 at the time of writing. The K4 Hatchback GT-Line starts at $26,090, while the top-end GT-Line Turbo 1.6 starts at $28,990. These prices do not include Kia’s destination charge of $1,245.
